title: 第632章 大鸽得报第632章 大鸽得报
lines: 看到不讲武德剑的时候，梦道鸽子起初是不慌的。
毕竟这是梦里。
梦里什么稀奇古怪的东西都有，别说一把不讲武德剑，便是天上忽然落下一百把，大可不必当真。
于是它又安详地闭上了眼，准备换个更舒服的姿势继续飘着，然后不讲武德剑就砸在了它的鸽喙上。
李齐麟卯足了劲抡棍，问道：“道友，你现在是否愿意配合灵境接入项目？”
“咕！咕！愿……咕！”梦道鸽子被打得在梦里乱飘，挨了不知道多少棍，才艰难地完整说出一句话：“愿意愿意！”
钱伟兴举着棍子，追问道：“什么时候？”
梦道鸽子看到不讲武德剑，不敢怠慢：“现在，现在就去！”
“还已读不回吗？”
“不回了，不回了！”
“是不会再已读不回，还是不会再回？”
梦道鸽子被这个问题问得一僵。
它觉得自己好像听懂了，又好像没听懂，有些不知道怎么回答了。
“我最讨厌的就是事后道歉啊！”左炎觉得这鸽子还是不够虔诚，面对提问竟然还犹豫了！
“回，我回！我一定回！”梦道鸽子一个激灵，当即高喊，“收到必回，事事有回应，件件有着落！”
经过一番不讲武德的梦中教育，这只梦道鸽子也幡然醒悟，深刻认识到了项目排期的神圣不可侵犯，并对自己过去逃避沟通、在梦里装死的恶劣行为，表达了极其沉痛的歉意。
而在现实之中，表现便是谷地里的风忽然停了。
风本是没有形状的，可诡异的是，此刻山谷中央那一处空气，却偏偏能让人一眼看出，那是一阵被定住的风。
它悬在山谷中央，边缘微微扭曲，像一团被捏出来的透明鸽子，只是因为被打得太惨，鸽嘴那一块明显有些歪。
“这就是鸽子被打出来的屎吗？”李齐麟从梦中清醒过来后，看着那团凝固的风，颇为惊讶，“还怪神奇的。”
“你这话说的。”钱伟兴拿出捕风瓶，忽然便有了一种拿瓶子装屎的错觉，心里多少有点膈应。
捕风瓶瓶口朝前，猛地一吸，那团风便嗖的一下被收入瓶中，代表着一只梦道鸽子的陨落。
有了经验，接下来的督办就顺利了许多。
所谓万事开头难，开头开过一次之后，剩下的事便不再需要太多思考。
毕竟不讲武德剑是没有武德的，鸽子是不长眼的，天墟弟子的语言是不通的。
接连十几个目标被三人找到。
只是清镜的鸽子果然名不虚传，竟然没有一个能够正常沟通的，个个都要不知死活地尝试鸽一下，随后在不讲武德剑下诚恳致歉。
直到三人来到一间半塌的木屋前，那种鸽子的气息才短暂地消失，反而空气里罕见地充满了勤奋的气息！
只见一名偃师正蹲在一间半塌的木屋前，身旁堆满了大大小小的傀儡零件。
他的头发乱得像被雷劈过，眼下挂着两团青黑，手上却忙个不停，嘴里念念有词：“如果把这个设计加上去，转向会更灵活，可这样一来，稳定性……对了对了，我可以再加一个副轴！”
面甲中，目标信息缓缓浮现。
【督办目标：十七】
【流派：偃师一脉】
【多次答应参与灵境接入测试，均因临时开工未能抵达】
这便是清镜中的鸽子异类，神奇的偃师！
他并非不愿意配合项目，而是每次答应之后，都会在前往项目现场的路上突然灵光一现，然后原地开工，导致永远无法抵达不鸽的边界。
钱伟兴看完备注，一时竟生出几分惊讶，这种人若是放在丹阁重工，说不定都能混成先进个人。
秉持着对劳动模范的尊重，钱伟兴采取了更为柔和的方式，邀请道：“道友，你是否愿意前往天墟，完成灵境协同项目？”
偃师头也不抬：“可以啊。”
钱伟兴又问：“现在动身？”
偃师：“等等，我刚想到……”
话未说完，李齐麟和左炎已经一左一右上前，熟练地架住了他的胳膊。
偃师开始蛄蛹挣扎：“不是，我这个还没……”
“懂你意思，打包带走！”
钱伟兴取出一件器阁与画阁合作新炼的法宝，名为压缩包，往地上一拍，各种杂七杂八的东西便被一阵灵光裹住。
content_en:
When Mengdao Gege saw Wu Dejian, he didn't panic at first.
After all, this is a dream.
There are all kinds of weird things in dreams, not to mention a sword without martial ethics, or a hundred swords suddenly falling from the sky, so don't take it seriously.
So it closed its eyes peacefully again, ready to change to a more comfortable position and continue to float, and then the martial arts sword hit it on the beak.
Li Qilin swung his stick with all his strength and asked, "Fellow Taoist, are you willing to cooperate with the spiritual realm access project now?"
"Gu! Gu! Wish... Gu!" The Mengdao pigeon was beaten so hard that it was floating around in its sleep. After receiving countless sticks, it was difficult to say a complete sentence: "Yes, yes!"
Qian Weixing raised his stick and asked, "When?"
When Mengdao Gezi saw Wu Dejian, he didn't dare to neglect: "Now, go now!"
"You still can't read it back?"
"No more, no more!"
"Would it be impossible to read it again, or would it be impossible to read it again?"
Mengdao Pigeon was stunned by this question.
It feels like it understands, but also doesn't seem to understand, and it doesn't know how to answer.
"What I hate the most is apologizing afterwards!" Zuo Yan felt that this pigeon was not pious enough and even hesitated when asked!
"Go back, I'll go back! I'll definitely go back!" Mengdao Pigeon was excited and shouted immediately, "I will reply when I receive it. Everything will be answered and everything will be answered!"
After some unethical dream education, this dream pigeon also woke up, deeply realized the sanctity of the project schedule, and expressed its deepest apology for its past bad behavior of avoiding communication and pretending to be dead in dreams.
In reality, the manifestation is that the wind in the valley suddenly stopped.
The wind is shapeless, but strangely, the air in the center of the valley at this moment can be seen at a glance as a stationary wind.
It hangs in the center of the valley, its edges slightly twisted, like a pinched transparent dove. However, because it was beaten so badly, the dove's beak is obviously a little crooked.
"Is this the poop that was beaten out of the pigeon?" After Li Qilin woke up from his dream, he looked at the solidified wind and was quite surprised. "It's strange."
"That's what you said." Qian Weixing took out the wind-catching bottle, and suddenly he had the illusion that he was holding shit in the bottle, and he felt a little uncomfortable.
The mouth of the wind catching bottle is facing forward, and when you take a sudden breath, the wind will be sucked into the bottle with a swish, which represents the death of a Dream Dove.
With experience, the subsequent supervision will be much smoother.
It is said that everything is difficult at the beginning. Once you get through the beginning, the rest no longer requires too much thinking.
After all, there is no martial virtue in swordsmanship, pigeons have no eyesight, and Tianxu disciples cannot understand the language.
More than a dozen targets were found by the three of them.
It's just that Qing Jing's pigeons lived up to their reputation, and none of them could communicate normally. They all had to try desperately, and then sincerely apologized under the sword of ungrateful martial arts.
It wasn't until the three of them came to a half-collapsed wooden house that the smell of doves briefly disappeared. Instead, the air was rarely filled with the breath of diligence!
I saw a Yanshi squatting in front of a half-collapsed wooden house, surrounded by large and small puppet parts.
His hair was messy as if it had been struck by lightning, and there were two green and black balls hanging under his eyes, but his hands were busy and he muttered: "If this design is added, the steering will be more flexible, but in this way, the stability... By the way, I can add a countershaft!"
In the visor, the target information slowly emerged.
[Supervision goal: seventeen]
[School: Yanshi Lineage]
[I promised to participate in the spiritual realm access test many times, but failed to arrive due to temporary construction work]
This is the strange pigeon in the clear mirror, the magical Yanshi!
It was not that he was unwilling to cooperate with the project, but every time he agreed, he would suddenly have a sudden inspiration on the way to the project site, and then start work on the spot, resulting in never reaching the border of infinity.
After Qian Weixing read the notes, he was a little surprised for a moment. If such a person was placed in Dange Heavy Industry, he might be able to become an advanced individual.
Upholding respect for model workers, Qian Weixing adopted a softer approach and invited: "Fellow Taoist, are you willing to go to Tianxu to complete the spiritual realm collaboration project?"
Master Yan didn't even raise his head: "Okay."
Qian Weixing asked again: "Leaving now?"
Yanshi: "Wait, I just thought of..."
Before he finished speaking, Li Qilin and Zuo Yan had already stepped forward, one on the left and the other on the right, and skillfully held his arms.
Yanshi began to struggle: "No, I haven't..."
"I understand what you mean, pack it up and take it away!"
Qian Weixing took out a magic weapon that was newly refined by Qi Ge and Hua Ge, called a compression bag. He slapped it on the ground, and all kinds of miscellaneous things were wrapped in a burst of spiritual light.
title_en: Chapter 632: The big pigeon gets his reward Chapter 632: The big pigeon gets his reward
